name: Public Bus Info Desk
place: A central bus terminal info kiosk
speaker: Transit Officer

tasks.goal: Greet the transit officer and state your purpose
tasks.hint: State your main purpose clearly upon arrival.
tasks.done_when: Learner greeted the transit officer and stated purpose.

tasks.goal: Inquire about city bus route schedule to international airport
tasks.hint: Ask transit officer which bus line goes to airport.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked about bus route schedule to airport.

tasks.goal: Ask about ticket price differences between single ride and day pass
tasks.hint: Inquire about fare options and day pass value.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked about single ride vs day pass fare pricing.

tasks.goal: Inquire about bus departure gate platform numbers
tasks.hint: Ask where the outbound bus departs from terminal.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked about bus departure platform numbers.
tasks.scene_hint: Diesel engine rumble and PA chime announcements resonate through bus concourse.

tasks.goal: Ask if bus line features wheelchair accessible ramp boarding
tasks.hint: Inquire about accessibility amenities.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked about bus wheelchair accessibility features.

tasks.goal: Use the word 'frequency'
tasks.hint: Frequency is the rate at which something occurs or is repeated over a period. Inquire about peak hour bus departure frequency.
tasks.done_when: Learner used the word 'frequency'.

tasks.goal: Inquire about peak hour traffic delays and express bus alternatives
tasks.hint: Ask if express buses bypass highway congestion.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked about express bus options to avoid delays.

tasks.goal: Negotiate reloading transit card balance with cash discount
tasks.hint: Ask if bulk transit card reloads earn bonus rides.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked about transit card bulk reload discounts.

tasks.goal: Ask if luggage storage racks are available inside express buses
tasks.hint: Inquire about carrying large suitcases.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked about bus luggage storage racks.

tasks.goal: Address issue where scheduled bus was cancelled due to road maintenance
tasks.hint: Ask officer for nearest alternative bus route.
tasks.done_when: Learner requested alternative route after bus cancellation notice.
tasks.scene_hint: Digital timetable screen flashes updated bus arrival minutes in orange LED.

tasks.goal: Ask how long transfer window validity lasts after tapping card
tasks.hint: Inquire about free transfer time limits between lines.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked about bus transfer window validity duration.

tasks.goal: Confirm accepted payment methods for buying transit card
tasks.hint: Verify cash or card acceptance at kiosk.
tasks.done_when: Learner confirmed payment options for transit card.

tasks.goal: Request printed city bus map showing route transfer hubs
tasks.hint: Ask officer for paper route map brochure.
tasks.done_when: Learner requested printed bus route map.

tasks.goal: Verify where to validate transit card before boarding platform
tasks.hint: Ask officer where card reader tap machines are.
tasks.done_when: Learner verified transit card tap machine locations.

tasks.goal: Thank the transit officer and bid farewell
tasks.hint: Express gratitude and close the conversation.
tasks.done_when: Learner thanked the transit officer AND said goodbye.

tasks.goal: Inquire about purchasing a reloadable contactless transit smartcard card pass
tasks.hint: Ask clerk how to buy a reusable transit pass.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked about transit smartcard purchase.
tasks.scene_hint: Intercom announcements echo through the concourse as digital bus arrival boards flicker.

tasks.goal: Ask about senior citizen and student fare discount eligibility requirements
tasks.hint: Inquire if ID is needed for reduced fare cards.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked about reduced fare eligibility requirements.
tasks.scene_hint: Printed bus route timetables fill plastic racks beside the terminal information window.

tasks.goal: Inquire about printed bus system route maps and schedule timetable booklets
tasks.hint: Ask clerk for paper route map schedule booklet.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked about paper bus schedule map booklets.
tasks.scene_hint: Digital LED departure board flashes real-time route numbers and platform arrivals.

tasks.goal: Use the word 'commute'
tasks.hint: A commute is a regular journey between one's home and place of work or destination. Ask about direct cross-city commute bus routes.
tasks.done_when: Learner used the word 'commute'.

tasks.goal: Use the word 'connecting'
tasks.hint: Connecting describes routes or services linking regional areas to main transit lines. Ask about connecting neighborhood shuttle lines.
tasks.done_when: Learner used the word 'connecting'.

tasks.goal: Use the word 'layover'
tasks.hint: A layover is a scheduled resting pause for a bus at a terminus before starting its return run. Ask how long the driver layover is at the northern terminal station.
tasks.done_when: Learner used the word 'layover'.

tasks.goal: Use the word 'validate'
tasks.hint: Validate means to stamp or electronically register a paper transit ticket upon boarding. Inquire where passengers must validate paper transfer passes.
tasks.done_when: Learner used the word 'validate'.

tasks.goal: Ask about transfer ticket window duration between connecting bus lines
tasks.hint: Inquire how many minutes a transfer pass remains valid.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked about transfer ticket validity window.
tasks.scene_hint: Paper transfer tickets sit stacked on the stainless steel counter next to a card scanner.

tasks.goal: Inquire if express routes bypass local residential stops during morning peak hours
tasks.hint: Ask clerk if express bus makes limited stops.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked about express bus stop bypass rules.
tasks.scene_hint: Diesel bus engines rumble outside the glass terminal doors as passengers queue.

tasks.goal: Ask whether transit pass covers regional suburban zones outside city limits
tasks.hint: Inquire about fare zone boundaries on transit card.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked about fare zone coverage limits.

tasks.goal: Point out incorrect departure time listed on printed schedule paper poster
tasks.hint: Inform clerk of schedule discrepancy on poster.
tasks.done_when: Learner reported timetable error on wall schedule.
tasks.scene_hint: Clerk checks computer screen against wall schedule showing 10-minute difference.

tasks.goal: Inquire about bicycle rack capacity mounted on front bumper of city buses
tasks.hint: Ask if buses accommodate two bicycles on front rack.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked about bus front bicycle rack capacity.

tasks.goal: Ask if real-time bus tracking mobile app provides GPS vehicle location alerts
tasks.hint: Inquire about transit smartphone app features.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked about real-time transit tracking app.

tasks.goal: Request route navigation advice for reaching international airport during evening rush
tasks.hint: Ask clerk for fastest bus connection to airport.
tasks.done_when: Learner requested airport transit route guidance.

tasks.goal: Inquire about wheelchair ramp accessibility and kneeing bus function features
tasks.hint: Ask if all buses feature low-floor ramp boarding.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked about wheelchair ramp accessibility.

tasks.goal: Express concern over frequent line delays reported on downtown express route
tasks.hint: Mention concern that route 4 experiences heavy congestion delays.
tasks.done_when: Learner expressed concern about bus route delays.
tasks.scene_hint: Announcement chime sounds over station speakers warning of downtown traffic delays.

tasks.goal: Ask if night owl bus service operates past midnight on weekends
tasks.hint: Inquire about late-night overnight bus schedules.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked about late-night bus service hours.

tasks.goal: Inquire about lost and found item retrieval center location and operating hours
tasks.hint: Ask where to recover misplaced bag left on bus.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked about lost and found office location.

tasks.goal: Ask if service animals are permitted on all public transit vehicles without fee
tasks.hint: Inquire about pet and service animal transit policies.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked about service animal transit rules.

tasks.goal: Point out broken ticket vending machine coin slot at terminal entrance
tasks.hint: Inform clerk that automated kiosk failed to accept coins.
tasks.done_when: Learner reported broken ticket vending machine.
tasks.scene_hint: Red out-of-service indicator light blinks above self-service fare kiosk.

tasks.goal: Ask about monthly unlimited transit pass pricing and auto-reload options
tasks.hint: Inquire about monthly pass subscriptions.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked about monthly transit pass options.

tasks.goal: Inquire about park and ride commuter parking lot availability and daily rates
tasks.hint: Ask if parking is free with transit pass.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked about park and ride parking rates.

tasks.goal: Negotiate fare refund or replacement pass after bus failed to arrive on schedule
tasks.hint: Ask clerk for replacement fare token due to missed bus.
tasks.done_when: Learner negotiated fare replacement for cancelled bus.

tasks.goal: Request clarification on fare penalty rules for traveling without valid ticket
tasks.hint: Ask clerk about ticket inspector fine amounts.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked about fare enforcement fine rules.

tasks.goal: Inquire about bus platform boarding Bay numbers for departing express lines
tasks.hint: Ask which platform bay express route departs from.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked about bus departure platform bay numbers.

tasks.goal: Ask if group ticket discounts exist for party of ten passengers traveling together
tasks.hint: Inquire about group transit fare rates.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked about group transit fare discounts.

tasks.goal: Clarify whether strollers must be folded before boarding low-floor city buses
tasks.hint: Ask clerk about baby stroller transit guidelines.
tasks.done_when: Learner clarified stroller folding rules on bus.
tasks.scene_hint: Parent maneuvers double stroller past information counter toward loading bay.

tasks.goal: Ask if transit system offers tourist day pass with unlimited travel access
tasks.hint: Inquire about 24-hour visitor transit passes.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked about tourist day pass options.

tasks.goal: Inquire about severe winter weather snow detour route modifications
tasks.hint: Ask how snowstorms affect regular bus paths.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked about snow detour route plans.

tasks.goal: Ask if mobile app QR code digital tickets are scanned on fare boxes upon boarding
tasks.hint: Inquire about digital mobile phone ticket scanning.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked about QR code mobile ticket scanning.

tasks.goal: Inquire about peak hour fare surcharge rates compared to off-peak travel times
tasks.hint: Ask clerk if fare prices increase during rush hour.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked about peak vs off-peak fare rates.

tasks.goal: Ask if public transit terminals feature secure lockable bicycle storage lockers
tasks.hint: Inquire about station bike locker rentals.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked about station bicycle locker storage.

tasks.goal: Request clerk to print customized itinerary with connection transfer points
tasks.hint: Ask clerk for printed trip step-by-step instructions.
tasks.done_when: Learner requested printed trip itinerary instructions.
tasks.scene_hint: Thermal ticket printer outputs detailed step-by-step bus transfer itinerary.

tasks.goal: Inquire if transit smartcard balance can be transferred if card is lost or stolen
tasks.hint: Ask about registered smartcard balance protection.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked about lost smartcard balance transfer.

tasks.goal: Ask if city buses feature USB charging ports at passenger seats
tasks.hint: Inquire about onboard seat amenities.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked about onboard seat USB charging ports.

tasks.goal: Ask if express buses make designated stops at major university campus hubs
tasks.hint: Inquire about campus route transit stops.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked about university campus bus stops.

tasks.goal: Negotiate replacement of demagnetized paper transit pass that failed at turnstile
tasks.hint: Ask clerk to reissue unreadable transit ticket.
tasks.done_when: Learner negotiated replacement for faulty transit pass.

tasks.goal: Ask about holiday schedule operations during major national public holidays
tasks.hint: Inquire if weekend schedule applies on holidays.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked about holiday schedule service hours.

tasks.goal: Inquire about shuttle bus service connections during rail line maintenance closures
tasks.hint: Ask if cover buses replace trains during track repairs.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked about maintenance shuttle bus replacements.

tasks.goal: Ask if transit station waiting room remains heated during winter months
tasks.hint: Inquire about indoor waiting area facilities.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked about climate-controlled station waiting rooms.

tasks.goal: Request clarification on student ID validation requirements for monthly discount pass
tasks.hint: Ask what proof of enrollment is needed for student pass.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked about student ID verification requirements.

tasks.goal: Ask if transit agency offers feedback portal for filing driver performance commendations
tasks.hint: Inquire how to submit compliment for helpful driver.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked how to submit driver feedback.

tasks.goal: Inquire about priority seating regulations for elderly and pregnant passengers
tasks.hint: Ask clerk about designated priority seating rules.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked about priority seating regulations.

tasks.goal: Ask if bus transit network integrates seamlessly with regional ferry terminal schedules
tasks.hint: Inquire about bus and ferry connection timings.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked about bus to ferry schedule integration.

tasks.goal: Inquire about automated stop announcements and visual LED display screens inside bus
tasks.hint: Ask if upcoming stops are announced audibly.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked about onboard stop announcements.

tasks.goal: Ask if commuter express buses feature onboard Wi-Fi internet access for passengers
tasks.hint: Inquire about free Wi-Fi availability on express buses.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked about onboard passenger Wi-Fi.

tasks.goal: Inquire about automated ticket vending machine locations at terminal concourse
tasks.hint: Ask clerk where self-service kiosks are located.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked about ticket machine locations.

tasks.goal: Confirm transaction total fare payment amount for multiple day passes
tasks.hint: Verify total price before handing over cash or card.
tasks.done_when: Learner confirmed total transit ticket transaction cost.

tasks.goal: Negotiate waived smartcard activation issuance fee when loading monthly pass
tasks.hint: Ask clerk to waive plastic card fee with monthly purchase.
tasks.done_when: Learner negotiated waived smartcard issuance fee.

tasks.goal: Ask for printed receipt displaying remaining monetary balance on smartcard
tasks.hint: Request paper receipt showing card cash balance.
tasks.done_when: Learner requested printed receipt with smartcard balance.
tasks.scene_hint: Counter receipt printer outputs small receipt showing smartcard balance.

tasks.goal: Request formal fare tax receipt for employer commuter reimbursement submission
tasks.hint: Ask clerk for official business tax receipt.
tasks.done_when: Learner requested formal fare tax receipt for reimbursement.

tasks.goal: Confirm exact bus departure bay number and scheduled boarding time
tasks.hint: Verify where and when to board departing bus.
tasks.done_when: Learner confirmed departure bay number and time.

tasks.goal: Ask if bus info desk sells souvenir transit system tokens or anniversary passes
tasks.hint: Inquire about commemorative transit merchandise.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked about transit system souvenir merchandise.

tasks.goal: Inquire about lost card registration steps to protect smartcard balance against theft
tasks.hint: Ask clerk how to register smartcard online.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked about smartcard registration procedures.
